title: Bare URL under-tested: an API/UI profile must derive user-input and reach input-validation and perf-baseline
context: Field-trial feedback (2026-10-05): given only a website URL, the agent ran a thin pass. user-input was never derived from any profile, so input and edge-case testing were marked not applicable, and load/perf never applied at all because every perf category required a declared perf-sensitive signal.
observed_failure: signalsFromProfile produced no user-input signal from an API or a frontend, so input-validation was not applicable; and no performance category existed below the perf-sensitive gate, so a reachable API got no performance coverage. A URL-only target silently skipped the two most common coverage holes.

environments.name: staging
evidence: user said this is the staging site

reasoning_notes: Any API surface or rendered UI accepts untrusted input, so user-input is derived and input-validation plus the edge-case baseline always apply.
perf-baseline applies to any reachable API or UI independent of a stated perf target; deep load/stress/soak still require perf-sensitive plus explicit authorisation and a non-production target.
e2e shows applicable even with no browser capability declared -- it resolves to BLOCKED, not not-applicable, so the gap is visible rather than silent.
